services.desc: Awake Boards are premium electric surfboards built for riders who want high performance and cutting-edge technology on the water. Designed with lightweight carbon fiber construction and powerful electric propulsion, they deliver an exciting, emissions-free riding experience on lakes and rivers in upstate New York. An Awake RÄVIK is a battery-powered, jet-propelled surfboard, requiring no boat, wake, or waves needed to ride it. On Lake George’s calm morning waters, riders can reach speeds up to 34 mph (depending on model) using a wireless hand controller, making it ideal for the lake’s protected coves and no-wake zones.
